intro: The technology sector bore the brunt of browser-security incidents tracked by ZCyberNews between April 11 and 30, 2026, with enterprises and global users also heavily affected. Nine articles covered a mix of two critical, three high, two medium, and one informational severity issues. The threat actor Pushpaganda was observed in these campaigns. Affected regions included Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and global targets.
